key.name: smooth-images
key.description: When off, zoomed pixels are shown as hard squares.

key.name: smoothing-style
key.description: text: rebuilds crisp edges for text and line art. soft: smooth bicubic scaling. standard: GNOME's own scaling.

key.name: edge-width
key.summary: Width of rebuilt edges, in screen pixels

key.name: edge-position
key.summary: Where rebuilt edges sit between the dark and light tone
key.description: Above 0.5 makes dark text on a light background bolder; below 0.5 makes it thinner.

key.name: follow-focus
key.description: When keyboard focus moves out of the zoomed view, move the view only as far as it takes to show it. Off leaves the view with the pointer, whatever GNOME's own focus tracking setting says.

key.name: follow-text-cursor
key.summary: Bring the text cursor into view
key.description: When a text cursor moves out of the zoomed view, by typing or by an app on its own, move the view only as far as it takes to show it. Off leaves the view with the pointer, whatever GNOME's own text cursor tracking setting says.

key.name: toggle-smooth-images
key.summary: Turn image smoothing on or off
